findings.evidence: Line 81 applies `@[expose]` section-wide, while lines 108–138, 163–169, 340–368, and 441–448 already provide public characterization lemmas for these definitions.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]` from the section and keep declarations opaque; add individual characteristic lemmas only if a downstream use cannot be expressed through the existing `*_apply`, membership, projection, decomposition, and carrier lemmas.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes the bodies of the entire public API, including `tensorComponent`, `tensorCoeffEquiv`, `weightProj`, `weightDecomposition`, `weightSpace`, and `weightSubcomodule`; consumers can therefore unfold implementation details instead of using the supplied interface.

summary: The new API unnecessarily exposes every declaration body, making downstream proofs depend on implementation details despite the available characteristic lemmas.
